Extend cmd_index() in src/main.rs to build the Tantivy search index after building the link graph. Call SearchIndex::build() with the parsed files. Only build/rebuild for files that need re-indexing (use the same mtime cache invalidation as the graph — files_needing_reparse() already identifies changed files). For --no-cache, rebuild the entire index from scratch (delete .zetl/search/ and rebuild).

Add new JSON output fields per CON-013-002:
  - search_index_docs: number of documents in the search index
  - search_index_size_kb: size of .zetl/search/ directory in KB

Add verbose stderr output per OBS-013-001:
  - Documents indexed, index size, index build time (ms)

Note on incremental indexing: For v1, the simplest approach is to delete and rebuild the full index when any file changes. Tantivy index merging is complex
